text_block_list.text: One night during the training camp—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer.
You wouldn't happen to be thinking something like this, would you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The sea god Poseidon granting me power...
Such things are nothing more than mythical pipe dreams."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still, Poseidon truly does exist.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come now, listen closely...
(Whooosh, whooosh!)
(Splash, splash...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear that sound emerging from the sea,
muffled beneath the crashing waves?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems they've arrived.
My Poseidon, bringing evolution with them...
(Splash, splash...)
I can certainly hear footsteps. But Poseidon... there's no way he actually exists...
Ke, kekeke, kekekekeke...!

"Sea gods don't really exist.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The “Phantom Bird” DOES exiiiiiist!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: !? You are...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The world's strongest, one wing of the Golden Generation,
and the one you are chasing after!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa has ar-riiii-ved, deeeeesu!
¡Bueno!

El Condor Pasa. One of the Golden Generation Umamusume
that T.M. Opera O looks up to as a rival.
A super Umamusume with a proven track record overseas appeared before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know who you are, Opera O.
The one aiming to become the strongest champion!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And now she's struggling. She's taking
focused attacks from everyone in the battle royale.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: H-How did you know about that...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There is not a single thing that El-El doesn't know, deeeesu. Because I'm always watching from high up in the sky.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Then allow me to spar with you.
So that I may teach you how to triumph with pride,
even when every eye is watching your every move!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, you say you will lend your strength to this "Overlord"?
You have my gratitude!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So first, what should we do?
Care for a tandem run?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's pro wrestling.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To learn how to fight, we must pro wrestle, yes!
Come, put on your ring costume!
And so, for some reason, T.M. Opera O ended up pro-wrestling with El Condor Pasa.
(Ding!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, Opera O, show me what you can do.
Show me the way of the Champion as you envision it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: How can I withstand a concentrated attack without yielding!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
First, try taking this, *deee-su*!
"Condor Rrrush"!
El Condor Pasa unleashes a barrage of chops! And TM Opera O...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! In that case, take this!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Operatic Dancing Dodge! Dodging every incoming attack with minimal movement!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is it! This is how a true champion fights!
With this, even under concentrated fire, I can conserve stamina and claim an overwhelming victory!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is what you wanted to convey.
El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see. Fighting that way would certainly
keep our losses to a minimum, yes. But...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That is not how a champion fights!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Running and running, sneaking your way to victory... Is that truly how a champion acts, yes?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, is that?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Winning like that cannot be called a victory... Anyone who does that is no champion... but a good-for-nothing, *yes*!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Gah! 'Good-for-nothing'!
What a humiliating title I've never received before!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To think that pursuing strength would turn me into a 'good-for-nothing Overlord.'
Ah, how pathetic of me..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El shall now demonstrate the fighting style
you should be aiming for!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, Opera O! Unleash your
greatest secret technique, please!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The Overlord's... ultimate secret art?! The very technique that wiped out the Six Great Galaxies in an instant?!

"There are far too many things to call out at this point,
so I decide to just watch quietly."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufufu... Then do not regret it
even if you are turned to dust, El-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold, my ultimate secret technique!
'Conqueror Principal Galaction'!!!
(Kshaaaaaaan!)

"An indescribable technique explodes.
And thenâ"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mmmrrgh!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! She took it head-on?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: How are you still standing!? More importantly, why didn't you dodge? You should have been able to avoid that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Because this... is how a true champion fights, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Weather every technique thrown at you—and win.
A true champion must never run away, even when marked by every rival, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because you take it head-on with pride, the fans are on the edge of their seats!
Because you fight back from there, the crowd goes wild!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Overpowering your rivals through sheer strength and taking them down! That's what a true champion does!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! She vanished?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAH!
(BOOOM!)

With a powerbomb straight out of a high-speed tackle,
El Condor Pasa buries T.M. Opera O into the sandy beach.
(Ding-dong-dang!)

Leaving behind a valuable lesson—
the match came to a close.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, El. Taking a good hit from you really woke me up.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if marked from all sides,
to face it head-on, endure everything, and win.
That is what makes a true "Overlord"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "No—that is precisely how the 'Overlord of the End of the Century' fights. Isn't that right?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sì, exactly. Trying to win by a massive lead is because one fears being overtaken, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The truly strong do not fear winning by a nose.
Because they have absolute confidence they won't be overtaken, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well then—ciao!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will definitely show the fruits of this in the race!

And so, the "Monstrous Bird" returned
once more into the sea...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Waaaah, *gasp* *splutter*! We didn't have to go through the ocean to get back, you knoooow!
